scope: Design and asset handoff only; no messages or invitations sent by this package.
entry: Existing member Team Info > Invite. Preserve caller beneath modal and restore focus on close.
friendInvite: Load only the player’s existing in-game friend graph, not phone contacts.
Use authenticated team membership and server canInvite/eligibility/limits. The fixture is not a policy that every team member may invite.
Send only after the player taps Invite on a particular friend row. Never on tab open or scroll.
Disable that row while pending. Refresh row state from confirmed response. Invited means invitation delivered/recorded, not team membership changed.
Use idempotency and reconcile unknown timeout outcomes before resending; no local fabricated success.
Already invited and same-team friends have text/check status rather than another active Invite action.
An invitation does not reserve a slot or bypass a required level, membership rule, approval policy, blocking or capacity.
sharing: Team code is public lookup information, separate from an expiring invitation token. Never display account IDs or auth tokens.
Copy code only after explicit tap; show Copied only if clipboard write succeeds. Keep text selectable as fallback.
Share only on explicit tap; invoke the actual OS share sheet. Do not imitate OS recipients in app UI.
Use server-configured approved invite URL and localized team name/code text. No hard-coded example URL, no automatic recipient selection.
Opening/dismissing a share sheet is not proof of a sent invitation. Return to Share without a false Sent status.
Offline may copy a previously verified stable public team code; disable URL generation and sending when freshness cannot be confirmed.
Code lookup is an extension to existing Find Team search; backend resolves code to teamId. A copied code cannot directly grant membership.
recipient: Resolve the invitation and refresh current team details before enabling View Team. Show sender/team identity from server.
View Team opens the existing approved Team Details/Join flow. It does not join immediately.
If already in this team, Open Chat is the correct action.
If in another team, existing join flow handles that state; never leave automatically.
Expired, revoked, deleted-team and full-team states have no implied successful join.
An incoming invite is shown through the host’s existing global inbox or invite-link entry, not a mailbox that only existing members can access.
Expiry countdown uses authoritative server time and is not hard-coded from the fixture.
privacyAndModeration: Respect existing blocked-user, report, age and social-privacy controls. Do not request contacts permission.
Allow only verified host-configured routes; never execute URL content or silently route to arbitrary external hosts.
Sanitize server-provided names and descriptions. UI uses live plain text.
excluded: Referral rewards or invitation coin charges
